messages:
Maya P: Good news — NDA with Orion Compute signed this morning :tada: They agreed to a two-week hardware preview window next month. Link to NDA: https://redwood-internal/partnerships/orion/nda (private)
Ollie Chen: awesome — when does access start? do we get keys / jumpbox?
Maya P: Access window is May 8-21. Orion will provide SSH keys + an S3 bucket. Need us to send onboarding checklist + bench plan by EOD Friday.
Kevin R.: I'll own the bench plan. Can someone confirm target models we should run? RLHF or standard transformer workloads?
Maya P: They suggested 1) Llama2-13B float32 2) Falcon-40B int8 3) one customer-style seq2seq prompt set (we'll provide). Also want latency p95, throughput, and memory footprint.
Partners Bot: Reminder: create partner workspace doc at /partnerships/orion-preview (auto-created)
Sam J: For infra, we need the node types + interconnect details from Orion to tune batch sizes. @Ollie can you ask for GPU model, PCIe vs NVLink, and driver version?
Ollie Chen: On it. Draft message to Orion: "Can you confirm GPU model, cuda/driver, NIC, and whether the nodes support MIG/partitioning? Also SSH jumpbox IP and S3 read creds."
Maya P: Perfect. Also include the compliance ask: logs retention, permitted screenshots under NDA, and whether we can upload small eval datasets to their S3.
Kevin R.: Proposed minimal bench run script: ```bash
# run token-gen perf
python -m bench.run --model {model} --dtype {dtype} --batch 1-8 --seq 512 --profile
```
Kevin R.: We'll collect p50/p95, tokens/s, GPU mem peak, and load time. Add mem vs batch sweep.
Sam J: We should also add a reproducibility note: seed, model checksum (sha256), and exact env (torch/cuda versions). I can add a small container recipe.
Maya P: Timeline proposal: Fri EOD — bench plan + onboarding checklist to Orion. Next Wed — we get keys. May 8-21 — run benchmarks and capture logs. May 24 — internal sync to decide public joint announcement (if any).
Ollie Chen: Risk check: if Falcon int8 fails on their stack, fallback is to run on our Dedicated cluster and mark it as "compatibility run" in the report.
Kevin R.: Agreed. We'll tag runs: "on_orion" or "fallback_redwood". Must be explicit in docs.
Maya P: Communication plan: week 1 status update channel + weekly debrief artifacts in that partner workspace. If we hit a regression vs baseline, immediate alert to eng-ml and partnerships.
Partners Bot: New task created: "Orion preview bench plan" assigned to Kevin R. due 2026-05-02
Sam J: I'll prep a small eval corpus (200 prompts) representing chat, code, and summarization. Need approvals on PII-free.
Maya P: I'll route the corpus to legal for quick PII check and confirm allowed uploads to Orion S3.
Ollie Chen: Once Orion replies with infra details I'll update runbook and add exact `--cuda` flags.
Maya P: Thanks team. Kevin — please drop the plan link here when ready, and I'll send it to Orion with the onboarding doc. :thumbsup:
Kevin R.: Will do — plan draft by 4:30pm PT.
Maya P: End of thread — followups in the partner workspace.
